gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.m: While wearing Travail and Boundless remains malicious:
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.w: While wearing Travail and Boundless has been witnessed:
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.d: While wearing "Free and Easy Wandering", press [%s] to Dream, entering Spectator mode for %s seconds.
Press the same key again while dreaming to wake early.
The skill cooldown is %s seconds, starting when Dream begins successfully.
If you wake inside solid blocks, high above ground, over the void or in another unsafe location, return to where you entered the dream.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.s: When the wearer takes damage from others, they have a %s%% chance to trigger a time stop for %s seconds.
Each roll starts a %s-second roll cooldown, whether or not it triggers a time stop.
When the wearer deals damage, a time-stop roll is made. Each roll has a %s%% chance to trigger a time stop lasting %s seconds.
A successful time stop adds a %s-second roll cooldown after it ends.
The time stop covers a fixed sphere with a radius of %s blocks, centered at the trigger location.
The caster, their teammates, and the companions and projectiles of both can act freely.
Overlapping time stops merge into one group. Each area still expires according to its own duration.
The entire group ends no later than %s seconds after its first time stop began. Merging does not restart the timer.
You cannot trigger another time stop while your own is still active.
If your time stop merges with others, you must wait until every other time stop in the group has ended before triggering another.
The additional post-stop roll cooldown for Witness also begins only after the entire group has ended.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.p: Carrying "Little Prince" grants creative flight and lets you step directly onto blocks at least %s blocks high.
Carrying multiple copies does not stack the effects.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.l: While wearing "Lorentz Fantasy", your arrows do not fall and gain %s piercing levels.
Sneak-right-click while holding it to enable or disable gravity-free arrows. This only affects arrows fired afterward.
Increase the wearer's Critical chance by %s%%
The wearer gains a %s%% damage bonus to projectile damage
An arrow headshot gains an additional %s%% damage bonus to that projectile hit

When a fired arrow hits a target, it additionally deals direct-strike damage equal to %s%% of the target's current health. This direct-strike damage is added even if the target is immune to projectile damage.
The trigger cooldown for the same shooter against the same target is %s seconds.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.boundless.t: Shapeless-craft "Ancient Strange Tales" with an item and 1 Nether Quartz to transfer the item's enchantments into this book.
Replace Nether Quartz with 1 Lapis Lazuli to transfer the book's enchantments into the target item.
If the target does not have the enchantment, transfer it at its original level.
If the target already has the enchantment, take the higher of the two levels and add 1, up to level 255.
When transferring matching enchantments, add extra crafting materials according to their level difference:
A difference of at most 10 levels requires no extra materials
A difference of 11–100 levels requires 1 Echo Shard and 1 Music Disc of any kind
A difference above 100 levels requires 1 Echo Shard, 1 Music Disc of any kind, 1 Nether Star and 1 Dragon Head
Extra materials apply to all enchantments in this craft and are not consumed separately for each enchantment.
If an enchantment lacks its required extra materials, it remains on the source item. Other eligible enchantments can still transfer.
You may also add one filtering ingredient:
Add 1 Honey Bottle to transfer only non-curse enchantments
Add 1 Fermented Spider Eye to transfer only curses
An enchantment cannot transfer if the target already has it at level 255
Only enchantments accepted by the target and compatible with its existing enchantments can transfer. Others remain on the source
Ancient Strange Tales can store any enchantment type, but two copies cannot transfer enchantments to each other
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.hi: You are considered high above ground if no collision surface can support your body within 5 blocks below your feet.
